“the stakes for our coverage has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our coverage have never been higher”
“federal goverment's” >>> “federal government's”
“more then ever” >>> “more than ever”
“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]
“it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”
“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”
“enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”
“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”
“Senator Whitfield (R-OH)” / “Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield’s state is inconsistent.]
“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”
“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The bill summary gives a maximum daily civil penalty of $1 million, not $10 million; verify the amount and whether the amendment keeps or changes it.]
“who's support” >>> “whose support”
“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”
“28 members, 13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: The vote categories total 29, not 28.]
“6 are undecided. The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow.” >>> [CHECK: Six undecided senators are claimed, but only five are named.]
“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”
“after the September 23 hearing” / “the committee's hearing on the risks of advanced AI occured on September 30” >>> [CHECK: If these refer to the same hearing, the dates conflict; verify the date or clarify that they were separate hearings.]
“seperate interview” >>> “separate interview”
“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached.” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached.”
“Commerce Commitee” >>> “Commerce Committee”
“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”
“occured” >>> “occurred”
“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The Section 6 summary specifies an international agreement within 18 months, not two years.]
“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”
“Our six Hill reporters” / “Each of our five Hill reporters” >>> [CHECK: The number of Hill reporters is inconsistent.]
“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”
“to there senators” >>> “to their senators”
“recieve updated notes” >>> “receive updated notes”
